recipes.name: Cocktail Special
ingredients: 4 mint leaves, plus a sprig for garnish
instructions: In an old fashioned glass filled with large ice cubes, add all three ingredients, and stir to combine. - 1 ½ ounces Kahlúa - 2 ounces vodka - 1 ounce heavy cream

Pour sweet vermouth over ice in an old fashioned glass. Twist lemon peel to release oils, and rub around the rim of the glass, adding the peel to the drink before serving. - 3 ounces sweet vermouth - 1 lemon peel

Place sugar cube in the bottom of an old fashioned glass, top with aromatic bitters, and muddle together. Add bourbon, and twist orange peel over top to release oils. Add to the drink, and stir until sugar is mostly absorbed. - 1 sugar cube - 3-4 dashes aromatic bitters - 2 ounces bourbon - 1 orange peel

Grind the mint leaves into the palm of your hand with your thumb to release the menthol. Place in a silver-plated cup with the sugar cube, and thoroughly muddle together. Add crushed ice until cup is 3/4 full - add bourbon, and stir to combine. Add seltzer, and top with enough crushed ice so it overflows out of the cup. - 4 mint leaves plus a sprig for garnish - 1 sugar cube - 2 ounces bourbon - 1/2 ounce seltzer

In a cocktail shaker filled with ice, combine gin, vodka, and lillet. Shake thoroughly, and double-strain into a chilled martini glass. Twist the lemon peel to release its oils, rub around the rim of the glass, and place in the drink. - 3 ounces Gordon’s gin - 1 ounce vodka - 1/2 ounce Kina Lillet - 1 lemon peel

In a cocktail shaker filled with ice, combine gin and lemon juice. Shake thoroughly. Strain into a chilled champagne coupe glass, top with champagne, and garnish with lemon peel. - 1 ounce gin - 1/2 ounce fresh lemon juice - 2 ounces champagne (or sparkling white wine) - 1 lemon peel

Combine all ingredients in a blender. Blend on high speed until completely smooth, and pour directly down the drain because it tastes like garbage and doesn’t work. - 1 ounce Funyuns - 1 banana peeled - 1 knob ginger peeled and sliced - 2 tablespoons bacon grease - 16 ounces Surge
